map.输入 3 项实测值与可调设计限值（区间项含上下限），逐项计算安全裕度并给出满足/: Enter three measured values and adjustable design limits (including range bounds); get a safety margin per item plus a meets/does-not-meet design limit verdict. Limits are user-supplied, with no fixed standard values.
map.拧紧扭矩裕度：min[(T实测 − T下限)/T下限, (T上限 − T实测)/: Tightening-torque margin: min[(measured T − lower limit)/lower limit, (upper limit − measured T)/upper limit] × 100%.
map.硬度裕度：min[(H实测 − H下限)/H下限, (H上限 − H实测)/H上: Hardness margin: min[(measured H − lower limit)/lower limit, (upper limit − measured H)/upper limit] × 100%.
map.尺寸偏差裕度：(e上限 − e实测) / e上限 × 100%。: Dimensional-deviation margin: (upper limit − measured e) / upper limit × 100%.

map.扭矩与硬度为区间项，裕度取「(实测 − 下限)/下限」与「(上限 − 实测)/上: Torque and hardness are range items: the margin is the smaller of (measured − lower limit)/lower limit and (upper limit − measured)/upper limit. Dimensional deviation is a one-sided upper limit: (upper limit − measured)/upper limit × 100%. Meeting its limit is shown as met, otherwise not met. Limits are entered by you from design documents, operating conditions and acceptance requirements; this page has no built-in standard thresholds.
map.取设计限值 扭矩 80~120 N·m、硬度 28~34 HRC、尺寸偏差 ≤0: With limits 80–120 N·m torque, 28–34 HRC hardness and ≤0.05 mm deviation, measured 100 N·m / 31 HRC / 0.03 mm gives margins +16.7% / +8.8% / +40.0%, minimum 8.8%, verdict "all 3 items meet design limits". If torque is 130 N·m and deviation 0.08 mm, margins are −8.3% and −60.0%, and the verdict becomes "2 items do not meet design limit".
map.这些设计限值是国标值吗？: Are these design limits standard values?

map.结果能用于质量验收吗？: Can the result be used for acceptance?
map.不能。本页只做数值比对，不执行试验，也不构成检测报告或验收结论。正式检测须由具备: No. This page only compares numbers; it runs no test and is not an inspection report or acceptance conclusion. Formal testing must be done by an accredited third-party lab.
map.区间项为什么取较小裕度？: Why use the smaller margin for range items?
map.区间项两侧都可能先触限，较小裕度对应更靠近的那一侧，能提前暴露风险；因此安全裕度: Either side of a range can be hit first; the smaller margin belongs to the nearer side and exposes risk earlier. The margin is therefore the smaller of (measured − lower)/lower and (upper − measured)/upper.
map.拧紧扭矩用 N·m，硬度用 HRC，尺寸偏差用 mm。实测值与设计限值必须使用同: Tightening torque in N·m, hardness in HRC, dimensional deviation in mm. Measured values and design limits must use the same unit.
map.实测值应来自同一测量条件、同一单位；扭矩与硬度建议使用标定过的量具: Measured values should come from the same measurement condition and unit; use calibrated instruments for torque and hardness.
map.设计限值须按设计文件、工况与验收要求填写，不要用本页默认值代替真实设计要求: Fill design limits from design documents, operating conditions and acceptance requirements; do not treat the defaults as real design requirements.
